title: Recipe 01 — CLI Coding Agent (the canonical starting shape)

beats.label: Open the recipe
beats.cue: “Recipe 01 is the shape to learn the system on — one agent, one chat loop, one process.”

beats.label: Start from a blank spec
beats.cue: live/ is scratch — the committed recipe is never touched by a take.

beats.label: Load the API key
beats.cue: [needs-key] Sources demos/.env for the run beats.

groups.title: Beat 1 · Step 1 — the smallest possible spec

beats.label: Type the recipe's opening spec
beats.cue: “Five lines of YAML: what it's called, which shape, and the agent. That's the whole harness.”

beats.label: Lint the spec
beats.cue: “Parse plus the IR passes the compile path skips — nothing emitted yet.”

beats.label: Show the lowered IR
beats.cue: “The spec is sugar; this JSON is what the compiler actually sees.”

verify.note: prints the IR for target cli

beats.label: Compile the bundle — and check it
beats.cue: “--check asserts the shape, installs the deps, and boots it: GREEN, no key needed.”

verify.note: GREEN — assertion ok (11 anchors); install ok; boot gated at the provider credentials gate

beats.label: Open the emitted agent
beats.cue: “Twenty-seven lines of TypeScript — the same bytes the recipe prints. You own the output, not a framework.”

beats.label: Launch the REPL
beats.cue: [needs-key] “crewhaus run compiles in memory and drops into a streaming chat loop.”

beats.label: Ask it something
beats.cue: [needs-key] Two sentences or fewer — the instructions hold.
beats.text: In one sentence: what does the CrewHaus compiler emit?

groups.title: One more thing · Steps 3–10, all at once

beats.label: Blank the scratch spec
beats.cue: “Now the recipe's Putting-it-all-together spec — tools, permissions, MCP, skills, commands, hooks.”

beats.label: Type the whole-harness spec
beats.cue: “Every step of the recipe, as one committed spec — forty-six lines.”

beats.label: Check the full bundle
beats.cue: “Same money beat, bigger spec: GREEN with no key.”

verify.note: GREEN — assertion ok; install ok; boot gated at the provider credentials gate

beats.label: Open the full agent
beats.cue: “Read the diff against the minimal bundle — that's what each step bought.”
